messages:
ravi: alert: unusual CreateGrant usage against KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xy98-76ab observed during nightly backups (02:43-02:47 UTC). Grants created with Name="backup-fallback" and no grantTokens. Possible longer-lived grants. tagging @zoe and @marta.

ops-bot: detected 4 CreateGrant events for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xy98-76ab from principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-runner between 2024-06-15T02:43:12Z and 2024-06-15T02:46:58Z. Alert ID: ENCOPS-5017.

zoe: can we get a snippet of the CloudTrail entry for one CreateGrant? need to confirm ttl or lack thereof.

ravi: pasted: {"eventTime":"2024-06-15T02:44:02Z","eventName":"CreateGrant","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-runner/i-012"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xy98-76ab","granteePrincipal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-runner","operations":["Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"]},"responseElements":{"grantId":"g-ff1122","name":"backup-fallback"}}

marta: that matches the fallback introduced in backup-agent v1.7.3 to avoid transient GenerateDataKey failures. Unfortunately the helper omitted grantTokens and TTL. commit a1b2c3.

cao: ops impact: we saw three S3 PutObject events to archive-main/tenant-buckets that don't match the intended tenant mapping. Also one EBS snapshot CreateSnapshot referencing volume vol-0abc at 02:46 with snapshot description including "backup-runner". Need to check if decrypt operations occurred using those grants.

eng-sre: verified list-grants shows active grants for key xy98-76ab. planning to retire matching grants in staging first. retire command prepared.

zoe: immediate mitigations: 1) retire matching grants, 2) revoke backup-runner sessions, 3) apply temporary S3 bucket deny policy for cross-tenant writes, 4) roll back agent fallback and patch create_grant usage to enforce transient grantTokens pattern. Also run object inventory for 02:40-03:00.

ravi: forensics checklist added to ticket ENCOPS-5017: collect CloudTrail, S3 access logs, EBS snapshot lineage, IAM AssumeRole logs, and list of affected tenant prefixes.

marta: patch PR open; adding wrapper that calls CreateGrant only via grant helper that returns grantTokens and stores ephemeral metadata in dynamo with TTL. adding unit test to fail if Name contains 'fallback' without token usage.

cao: customer impact scan: writes observed to tenant-9 and tenant-21 prefixes; snapshots appear to be internal backups (no public snapshot share), but we need to validate snapshot encryption state and whether any kms:Decrypt calls used the grants.

eng-sre: staging revoke successful. prod revoke scheduled after PR merges. will run retire-grant and then list-grants to confirm.

zoe: follow-ups: add config-policy rule to detect CreateGrant without correlating GrantToken issuance, tighten IAM uploader policy to enforce s3:prefix or aws:RequestTag checks, and add weekly audit that lists non-expiring grants. assigning owners: marta (patch), cao (policy), ravi (detection). reconvene in 48h for postmortem.

ravi: thanks all, filing customer-notify draft once we confirm scope. ops-bot: ENCOPS-5017 status -> mitigation-in-progress.
